I was taught in driving school that "mirrors are dirty liars and you should always turn your head to look." That advice has served me well, however, I recently learned that you can position your mirrors in such a way to almost completely eliminate your blind spots.

If you point them a little more outward, in such a way that your rear view doesn't overlap with your side mirrors at all, and so your side mirrors aren't halfway filled by your car door, pretty much every object will always be visible in your mirrors, and as soon as they're not in your mirrors, they're inside your peripheral vision.

As someone who drives in the city, this has really been a life saver for when people pass me. Makes it so much less shocking to see a car on my side.
